data.exact_reserve_text: Overall on an aggregate basis, reserves strengthening of GBP 4.4m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2015. In 2014 there was a reserve release of GBP 2.6m.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Cargo account suffered losses arising from business written in 2014 leading to adverse development and reserve strengthening.
Immature nature of the professional liability account and additional detailed review/data led to strengthening of reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 was GBP 102.816m. During 2015 the syndicate recorded a net strengthening of prior year reserves of GBP 4.4m (net of reinsurance), driven principally by adverse development in the cargo element of the marine account (losses on business written in 2014) and by the immature professional liability book where additional data and detailed review prompted reserve increases. No gross prior-year movement figure was disclosed; the report states the net movement of GBP 4.4m.
raw_causal_phrases: reserves strengthening of GBP 4.4m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2015.
In 2014 there was a reserve release of GBP 2.6m.
The reserve strengthening in 2015 was generated by the Professional Liability and Cargo accounts.
The marine account has suffered from a number of larger losses and in particular the cargo account has suffered from losses arising from business written in 2014.
This has led to a strengthening of the reserves held during 2015.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement amount was located in the 'movement in prior years' note; only a net figure is stated ('reserves strengthening of GBP 4.4m net of reinsurance'). Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the reported NET of reinsurance figure (fallback). The formal segmental analysis note (page 19) was partially unreadable in the scan; gross_premium_mix above uses the Managing Agent summary table (page 3) as a pragmatic substitute.
